SETTINGS_RESTORE_PURCHASES_PROMPT: Restoring your purchases will allow you to claim any previously purchased, non-consumable items from the store, including premium Plants and Upgrades, and purchased Worlds.
SHADOWPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fires piercing bolts when powered
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hides and swallows zombies that approach
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}bolt stall effect lasts for 2 seconds on the first zombie, -0.5 seconds for each subsequent zombie, down to 1 second

{FLAVOR}"Phoot," Shadow Peashooter says, emitting a shadowy, ah, hmmm, I guess you could call it a pea, at a distant zombie. "Uph!" gasps the zombie in evident surprise. There's a lot going on under the surface between these two.
SHADOWPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Shadow Peashooters are shadow plants that fire shadowy peas at zombies.
SHADOWSHROOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on being eaten
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}powered Shadow-shrooms make poisoned zombies poison other zombies

{FLAVOR}Despite being such a poisonous and profoundly inedible fungus, Shadow-shroom is nonetheless a total cutie-pie.
SHADOWSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Shadow-shrooms poison zombies who touch them, inflicting damage over time.
SHINEVINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}best used on sun producer plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}briefly stuns close zombies and makes them drop small sun

{FLAVOR}"Peek-a-boo!" giggles Shine Vine, staring directly at you, the player. "Consider that fourth wall SHATTERED!"
SHINEVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Shine Vines are vine plants that amplify the sun production of sun producer plants.
SHRINKINGVIOLET_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}shrinks imps to oblivion

{FLAVOR}Shrinking Violet started out shy, but it's remarkable how discovering a magical talent for zombie-reduction can change your whole outlook.
SHRINKINGVIOLET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Shrinking Violets shrink zombies in an area, forcing them to take 50% more damage and reducing the bite damage they inflict.
SHRINKINGVIOLET_TOOLTIP: Shrinks zombies and makes them weaker
SLINGPEA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can target anywhere on the lawn, prioritizes zombies in front

{FLAVOR}Sling Pea keeps a keen eye on the whole battle space. He's alert and attentive. "If something slips through," he muses quietly, "it would be my fault. And I just couldn't forgive myself if that happened."
SLINGPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sling Peas fire 5 peas in a burst, targeting the zombies closest to your house each time.
SLOT_UNLOCKED: A new pot is available for sprouts!
SNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Area: {STAT}damages all zombies in the 6 tiles in front of it
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost

{FLAVOR}Although the most powerful dragon in the plant kingdom, he still dreams of wings and seeing the world beneath him.
SNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Snapdragons breathe fire that causes damage in 6 adjacent tiles.
SNAPDRAGON_PLANTFOOD: Creates a 3x3 patch of fire that does massive damage.
SNAPDRAGON_TOOLTIP: Breathes fire in an area in front of it
SNAPPEA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}entire lane
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}chews zombies for 12 seconds before shooting out a head for damage
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}has a delay of 2.5 seconds after firing head shot before swallowing again, delay of 4 seconds when attacking a zombie that can't be swallowed

{FLAVOR}"I'm a picky eater, I'll admit it," admits Snap Pea casually. "I'll eat a zombie, no problem, but there's just something about heads. I feel like they're looking at me."
SNAPPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Snap Peas dive underground, burrow towards zombies, then pop up underneath to swallow them in one gulp. Snap Peas then return to their starting spot, chew on the entire matter for a while, and finally spit the zombies' heads out at attackers.
SNAPPEA_TOOLTIP: Eats zombies and spits out their heads
SNOWPEA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}has a chance of shooting a frosty pea
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}frosty peas deal more direct damage, have splash chill effects, and travel faster

{FLAVOR}As a professional table tennis player, in the off-season he also enjoys skiing, playing the bongos, and spelunking.
SNOWPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Snow Peas fire frozen peas making it hard for zombies to advance.
SNOWPEA_PLANTFOOD: Fires a stream of frozen peas and creates a sheet of ice that chills everything in its lane.
SNOWPEA_TOOLTIP: Shoots frozen peas that damage and slow zombies
SOLARPEA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to switch mode
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}lobbing mode fires up to 3 solar peas on any row in front of Solar Pea
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}zombies defeated by Solar Pea drop sun
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}Compared to her fellow sun plants in the greenhouse, Solar Pea prefers a much more "direct" approach in persuading zombies into participating with the secondary sun production process. "It's a harsh method, but those zombies wouldn't be so hurt if they let in a little bit of sun into those dingy crypts of theirs every once in a while," Solar Pea explains. "Thankfully, many gardeners out there enjoy the feeling of the sun on their skin, it's part of the gardening process after all and it's wonderful, wouldn't you agree?"
SOLARPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Solar Pea can be tapped to switch between a straight-firing and lobbing mode.
SOLARPEA_TOOLTIP: Tap on Solar Pea to switch between straight-shot or lobbed mode
SOLARSAGE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}illuminated zombies have a chance to illuminate another zombie
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}vulnerable to critters and mechs

{FLAVOR}"Ommm," Solar Sage hums softly to herself. But she's not kidding anybody. We all know her mind is filled with race cars and bulldozers.
SOLARSAGE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Solar Sages illuminate zombies, causing them to make better choices and depart, leaving behind a trail of sun.
SOLARTOMATO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}Solar Tomato wishes folks would just stop and enjoy the sunshine sometimes.

"Stop," she says. "Enjoy the sunshine. I said stop! Hold it right there! Don't move! I MEAN IT!!!"
SOLARTOMATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Solar Tomatoes stun zombies in a 3x3 area, causing each zombie to drop 25 sun.
SPEARMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Spear-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Bloomerang
{STAT}Bowling Bulb
{STAT}Cactus
{STAT}Cattail
{STAT}Cold Snapdragon
{STAT}Dartichoke
{STAT}Fanilla
{STAT}Homing Thistle
{STAT}Laser Bean
{STAT}Pokra
{STAT}Rotobaga
{STAT}Snapdragon
{STAT}Spikerock
{STAT}Spikeweed
{STAT}Starfruit

{FLAVOR}"Slash!" Spear-mint enthuses. "Slishy-slashy-slice!" she adds, wanting to make sure she's getting her point across. She wants to be very clear on this.
SPEARMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Spear-mints generate a number of Spikeweeds on the board and provide a temporary boost to all Spear-mint Family plants on the lawn.
SPEEDDOWN1: Have Olive Pit or Pop Jam slow
SPEEDDOWN2: Have Sweet Pea Plant Food slow
SPEEDDOWN4: Have Tar or The Great Zucchini slow
SPEEDUP1: Have Valenbrainz Perfume or Metal Jam boost
SPEEDUP2: Have Taste of Big Wave Beach or Punk Jam boost
SPEEDUP3: Have ZCorp Juice Box or Love Bomb boost
SPIKEROCK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can't be eaten by zombies
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can take three hits from rolling zombies

{FLAVOR}Being the most metal plant, Spikerock has decided to hold his ultimate metal plant concert at Madison Rock Garden. Tickets have been sold out for many harvests.
SPIKEROCK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Spikerocks destroy multiple rolling zombies and damage zombies that walk over them.
SPIKEROCK_PLANTFOOD: Metal spikes push all zombies in its lane onto itself, damaging them in the process.
SPIKEROCK_TOOLTIP: Breaks 3 rolling objects, hurts zombies that step on it
SPIKEWEED_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can't be eaten by zombies
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}crushed by rolling zombies

{FLAVOR}Although Spikeweed grew up on the seedy side of town, his acupuncture business has been blooming.
SPIKEWEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Spikeweeds destroy one rolling zombie and hurt any zombies that step on them.
SPIKEWEED_PLANTFOOD: Spikes push all zombies in its lane onto itself, damaging them in the process.
SPIKEWEED_TOOLTIP: Breaks 1 rolling object, hurts zombies that step on it
SPLITPEA_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"It's my turn with the eyebrows," said Frontie. "Fine, we'll split them," said Backie. Sprouted two minutes apart, their eyebrow war is eternal.
SPLITPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Split Peas shoot peas forward and backwards.
SPLITPEA_PLANTFOOD: Performs the Plant Food effect of the Peashooter to the front and the Repeater to the back.
SPORESHROOM_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"My favorite arithmetic operation?" wonders Spore-shroom. "I guess I’d have to say, um, addition. Hang on, no... multiplication."
SPORESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Spore-shrooms fire spores that create new Spore-shrooms out of defeated zombies.
SPORESHROOM_TOOLTIP: Spawns new Spore-shrooms from defeated zombies
SPRINGBEAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pushes zombies back, or into the water
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}gets sleepy after springing

{FLAVOR}He's the strong, silent type and little is known about Spring Bean. What is known though: his fan club is a million followers strong. And the ladies love him.
SPRINGBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Spring Beans bounce back zombies that get too close. Will bounce them into water if nearby.
SPRINGBEAN_PLANTFOOD: Slams down, causing all zombies on the lawn to bounce back to the right.
SPRINGBEAN_TOOLTIP: Bounces zombies back and into nearby water
SPRINGPRINCESS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below, prioritizes leftmost zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}springs land randomly in a 3x3 area around zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}springs deal extra damage to zombies that can't be knockbacked
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}springs disappear over time

{FLAVOR}She prefers autumn.
SPRINGPRINCESS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Spring Princess launches springs that bounce zombies back.
SPRINGPRINCESS_TOOLTIP: Launches springs that bounce zombies back
SPROUTS_STORE_TEXT: Need more sprouts? Choose a package below.
SQUASH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates when zombie is close
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}prioritizes zombies behind it

{FLAVOR}Squash is actually his stage name. His birth name was Tracy.
SQUASH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Squashes will smash the first zombie that gets close.
SQUASH_PLANTFOOD: Squashes multiple tough targets on the lawn before returning to its original location.
STACKABLESLOW: Apply Goo Peashooter's slowdown effect to
STALLIA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact

{FLAVOR}"Life moves too quickly in our modern world," says Stallia. "Folks need to slow down and smell some spores."
STALLIA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Stallias stall zombies with a puff of perfume.

STARFRUIT_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Just a small town fruit that travelled to the big city and found his way to the future. His favorite modes of transportation: conveyor belts, hoverboards, and rockets. WEEEEE!
STICKYBOMBRICE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below, prioritizes leftmost zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can lob backwards
{KEYWORD}Damage Details: {STAT}exploding sticky bombs trigger other sticky bombs

{FLAVOR}Stickybomb Rice has extreme confidence in bombs, rice, and the abstract concept of stickiness. She's published scholarly articles about all three.
STICKYBOMBRICE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Stickybomb Rice lobs sticky rice bombs with timers at zombies.
STORE_BUNDLES_ALL_PROFILES: Plants and Upgrades you buy in the store will be bought for all profiles
STORE_COINS_CURRENT_PROFILE: Coins you buy in the store will only be bought for the current profile

STORE_MULTI_CATEGORY_INTRO: The {COUNT} seed packets are an assortment of:

STORE_TICKETS_CURRENT_PROFILE: Gauntlets you buy in the store will only be bought for the current profile

STRAWBURST_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to fire

{FLAVOR} "Big is good," says Strawburst. "Though small’s pretty choice as well. And you should never discount medium. I just like sizes, really."
STRAWBURST_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Strawbursts grow a berry for small, medium or huge damage!
STRAWBURST_TOOLTIP: Grows a berry for small, medium or huge damage
STUNION_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact

{FLAVOR}Oh sure, everyone knows Stunion as the battle-hardened warrior with the potent breath. But he’s so much more than that. He’s an accomplished pianist. He speaks five languages fluently. Heck, he's the leader of a Cub Shallots group in his spare time. Dude’s got layers. Go on, peel 'em back. You’ll see.
STUNION_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Stunions breathe a stunning cloud of gas on nearby zombies in the lane.
STUNION_PLANTFOOD: Immediately breathes a large cloud of stunning gas to the right, across three lanes.
STUNION_TOOLTIP: Stuns nearby zombies in the lane
SUCCULENTGRAPE_DESCRIPTION: In the grape family, Succulent Grape has always been the third child, but every time people mention that he is not like Grapeshot and Microwave Grapes, he always says that he is the youngest (a little secret: Succulent Grape is actually short-sighted).
SUCCULENTGRAPE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Succulent Grape lobs explosive grapes above his head, dealing stun damage.
SUGGEST_TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION: Need help choosing plants? Power Picks will set you up with aggressive attackers, a brawny guardian, and the right sun producer you need to win.
SUNBEAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on being eaten
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}infected zombie drops 0.2 sun per hitpoint, up to 300 sun per Sun Bean

{FLAVOR}As the eldest of the bean brothers, Sun Bean often finds his siblings exasperating. Chili Bean is a little crude, Laser Bean is too far out, and Spring Bean is just plain lazy. Still, he loves them just the same. That's how it is with family.
SUNBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sun Beans infect zombies with sun. As a zombie takes damage it generates sun.
SUNBEAN_TOOLTIP: Zombies that eat it drop sun when damaged
SUNCARRIER100: Inflict Sun Tarot Card effect on
SUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}After the release of her first major YouTuber video "Zombies On Your Lawn," Sunflower's YouTuber channel has been bursting with fun. She is currently putting the final touches on her reality show TV pitch "Sunflower Thinks She Can Dance."
SUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sunflowers are essential for you to produce extra sun. Try planting as many as you can!
SUNSHROOM_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Oh sure, Sun-shroom is known for his ever-present grin and sunny disposition. But truth be told, even he has his dark days. It ain't easy keeping things light when you live in the shadows.
SUNSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sun-shrooms give small suns at first, then normal suns, and finally large suns.
SWEETPEA_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}No one knows what flavor their candy is, and those who try to find out get trapped in a rabbit hole of chocolate factory conspiracies, government cover-ups, and missing Zombie reports. However, Sweet Pea doesn't get why their cherry flavor has such a direct reaction. "Trust me, I'm as lost as you."
SWEETPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sweet Pea shoots candy peas that split into shards upon contact, spreading out and dealing damage to other zombies.
SWEETPOTATO_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Sweet Potato really is as sweet as she looks. Her favorite animal is the unicorn. Her favorite color is (and this is a direct quote) "all the colors of the rainbow." When she writes the letter "i", she draws a little heart where the dot belongs. Frankly, if it were anyone else, this amount of syrup would be sickening. But on her, well, it just seems right.
SWEETPOTATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sweet Potatoes attract zombies from other lanes when they are close by.
SWEETPOTATO_TOOLTIP: Attracts zombies from other lanes when they are close
SYNC_DATA_INFO:
"By registering your account, your player data will be merged across available player IDs to ensure all progress across devices and platforms is kept. You can also force sync your data for your current player ID to ensure you are up-to-date with what is stored on our servers.
To see your current player IDs, go to Settings -> Download Preferences."

SYNC_FAILED_TO_SAVE_BODY: We were unable to save your player data to our game servers for. Please find a more stable internet connection or try again later.

SYNC_SAVING_DATA: Saving player data to game server...
SYNC_SUCCEEDED_BODY: Player data was saved with the game server and reloaded.
TALLNUT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blocks launched imps

{FLAVOR}Tall-nut is opening a chain of stores for Tall and Taller gentlemen. "I'll shell out the savings to you!"
TALLNUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tall-nuts are heavy-duty wall plants that block low flying zombies.
TALLNUT_PLANTFOOD: Becomes encased in metal armor, greatly increasing its health.
TALLNUT_TOOLTIP: Heavy-duty wall that blocks low flying zombies
TANGLEKELP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on contact

{FLAVOR}Tangle Kelp likes to go deep. He majored in philosophy. Grab a root beer with him, and he'll go on and on about Nietzsche's "Thus Spoke Zucchini" or hold forth on Kant's "Critique of Petunia Reason." It's cool and all, but sometimes you just want to keep the conversation light. Sometimes you just want to talk about the temperature of the water.
TANGLEKELP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tangle Kelp are aquatic plants that pull the first zombie that nears them underwater.
TANGLEKELP_TOOLTIP: Aquatic plant that pulls a zombie underwater
TELEPORTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use

{FLAVOR}Teleportato Mine is an avid film and movie fan, she'll ramble on and on about all the cool effects and physical props for them, to the point where she attempts to recreate them with a pretty decent success rate. Her recent obsession? Starch Trek. Cross your fingers and hope she doesn't watch the Termitater.
TELEPORTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Teleportato Mine instantly teleports zombies to her location, then explodes.
TELEPORTATOMINE_TOOLTIP: Teleports zombies to explode alongside them
TERRIFIED: Have T. Rex or Witch's Brew boost
TEST_FEASTIVUS_QUEST_DESC: Defeat Treasure Yetis before they totally overrun Feastivus!
TEST_WIN_RIFT_LATEST_LEVEL_QUEST_DESC: Chase down Dr. Zomboss and earn coins while doing it!
TEST_WIN_RIFT_LATEST_LEVEL_QUEST_TITLE: Play Most Recent Penny's Pursuit Level!
THREEPEATER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Threepeater loves playing multiplayer in video games, but split-screen never works out because the left head always cheats.
THREEPEATER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Threepeaters shoot peas in three lanes.
THREEPEATER_PLANTFOOD: Fires off a waving wall of peas across the lawn.
THYMEWARP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}rewound zombies have restored health

{FLAVOR} "Possibilities other to open be to need we." Warp Thyme says, "Limited too far was time to approach unidirectional the that felt always I've."
THYMEWARP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Thyme Warps rewind time, sending zombies back where they started.
THYMEWARP_TOOLTIP: Sends zombies back where they started
TIGERGRASS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}grass tiger grows over time

{FLAVOR}"How many Grass Tigers could a Tiger Grass amass before they'd tire of making Grass Tigers?" We've presented this riddle to both the Sphinx and The Grate Mystery, and even they still couldn't solve it, and they studied the Suburban Almanac cover to cover.
TIGERGRASS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tiger Grass spawns a grass tiger who leaps out to attack nearby zombies.
TOADSTOOL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}takes 25 seconds to swallow a zombie
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}deals damage to zombies that can't be gulped

{FLAVOR}Toadstool just can’t stand being idle. "I keep everything that I want to do on lists, and keep the lists where I can see them so that I’m always motivated!" she said. Whenever there’s work to be done, she’s always the first to hop to it.
TOADSTOOL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Toadstools gulp down zombies whole, then produce sun.
TOADSTOOL_TOOLTIP: Gulps down zombies whole, then produces sun.
TORCHWOOD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}multiple torchwoods increase strength of fire peas
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}does minor lane-wide fire damage when destroyed
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}Torchwood and Snapdragon have become fast friends. They like to hang out at either the Tiki Lounge or the Renaissance Faire.
TORCHWOOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Torchwoods turn peas that pass through them into fireballs that deal twice as much damage. They also deal lanewide fire damage on defeat.
TORCHWOOD_PLANTFOOD: Permanently turns into a blue-fire version, with blue-fire peas doing twice the damage of fire peas.
TORCHWOOD_TOOLTIP: Turns peas into fireballs and does lanewide damage on defeat
TRANSPARENT: Have Arbiter-X or Royal Princess Zombie boost

TUMBLEWEED_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}set aflame by Torchwood
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can be planted on top of other plants

{FLAVOR}This zesty little guy can't wait to get at it! Places to do! Things to go! It works because he planned thoroughly ahead of time.
TUMBLEWEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tumbleweeds roar off down the lane, bouncing off zombies and knocking them back with a chance to stun them.
TURKEYPULT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}turkeys naturally rot over time and disappear

{FLAVOR}Turkey-pult’s turkeys are so delicious, you’d never know they were actually made of tofu! Almost never. You might know. Okay, fine, cards on the table: there is absolutely no way you could ever mistake these turkeys for the real thing.
TURKEYPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Turkey-pults lob tofu turkeys that damage zombies and then charge down the lane to damage even more zombies.
TUTORIAL_POWERUPS_HAVE_FUN: Now have fun with Power Ups!
TUTORIAL_POWERUPS_KILL_ALL_ZOMBIES: Kill all the zombies before the timer runs out!
TUTORIAL_POWERUPS_USE_POWERUP: Great! Now use the Power Up!
TUTORIAL_POWERUPS_ZOMBIE_WAVE: Great, now don't let these zombies eat your brains!
TWINSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Twin Sunflower's super-chic line of ultra-expensive sunglasses has been a huge hit wherever she goes. Due to this she has been unable to travel without being swarmed by the Poppyrazzi.
TWINSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Twin Sunflowers give twice as much sun as a normal sunflower.
TWINSUNFLOWER_TOOLTIP: Gives twice as much sun as a sunflower
ULTOMATO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can be planted on top of itself, mutating from green to yellow to red
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}costs more sun the more Ultomatoes are on the board

{FLAVOR}Ultomato yawns as unimaginable energies build up inside his being. It’s cool. He can afford to wait. He’s got allllll day.
ULTOMATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Ultomatoes charge up slowly, then fire a devastating beam down the lane that damages zombies as long as the charge lasts. Ultomatoes can be made more powerful by planting multiple Ultomatoes on the same tile.
UNLOCK_BEACH_DESC: Use a World Key to unlock the holiday horrors of the Big Wave Beach!
UNLOCK_COWBOY_DESC: Use a World Key to unlock the pioneering predicaments of the Wild West!
UNLOCK_DARK_DESC: Use a World Key to unlock the midnight mysteries of the Dark Ages!
UNLOCK_DINO_DESC: Use a World Key to unlock the mesozoic madness of Jurassic Marsh!
UNLOCK_EIGHTIES_DESC: Use a World Key to unlock the musical mayhem of the Neon Mixtape Tour!
UNLOCK_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_DESC: A mysterious book came into your possession. What thrilling tales are hiding amidst its pages? Purchase the Malice in Wonderland book from the shop!
UNLOCK_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_DESC: Time has taken it's toll on the Frostbite Caves. As the ice age worsens, zombies have adapted. Purchase the Hypothermic Hollows key to gain access!
UNLOCK_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_DESC: An other-worldly being is blurring boundaries in search of heroes. Purchase the Border Card and travel to a strange new world!
UNLOCK_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_DESC: Alert, alert! An S.O.S. is awaiting! Purchase the Aerial Distress Call from the shop to rescue whoever needs help!
UNLOCK_FIND_MORE_TOOLTIP: Collect limited time seed packets during the {PLANT} event to unlock.
UNLOCK_FIND_MORE_TOOLTIP_PRODUCT: Collect limited time seed packets during the {PLANT} event to unlock.

UNLOCK_FUTURE_DESC: Use a World Key to unlock the electric excitements of the Far Future!
UNLOCK_HOLIDAY_DESC: Use your newfound Holiday Mashup Key to access the mashed-up mania of Holiday Mashup!
UNLOCK_ICEAGE_DESC: Use a World Key to unlock the chilling challenge of the Frostbite Caves!
UNLOCK_LOSTCITY_DESC: Use a World Key to unlock the historical hazards of the Lost City!
UNLOCK_MODERN_DESC: Use a World Key to unlock the contemporary calamity of Modern Day!
UNLOCK_PIRATE_DESC: Use a World Key to unlock the marine mischief of the Pirate Seas!
UNLOCK_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_DESC: Wash up back on the shores of Big Wave Beach with new zombies to rescue Acid Lemon! Purchase the Big Beach Brawl quest from the store!
UNLOCK_STEAM_DESC: Use a World Key to unlock the industrial insanity of the Steam Ages!
UNLOCK_ZEN_SLOT_DESCRIPTION: Opens up another pot to plant sprouts and earn sweet loot and boosts!
UNUSED_43_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}stun stops Gentleman Zombies from flying

{FLAVOR}Some folks confuse Fanilla for a wind turbine. Others confuse him for a zombie, because he has really bad breath and makes no effort to change that. Fanilla isn’t good at making positive first impressions.
UNUSED_43_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Fanillas shoot stunning wind, which gets more powerful as it goes down the lane.
UNUSED_45_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}potions slow down zombies and pierce through armor

{FLAVOR}Lily of Alchemy learned the ancient art of potion-making from Old Man Josslehoof, who taught her the exact ingredients for the perfect, top secret anti-Zombie chemicals in her potions. Old Man Josslehoof also lives in a sewer and frequently combats giant dwarf overlords, according to Lily. What a guy.
UNUSED_45_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lily of Alchemy lobs flower buds and has a chance to throw armor-piercing, stalling potions.
UNUSED_46_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}water pellets evaporate shortly after being fired

{FLAVOR}Lotus Root is a senior environmentalist. Whenever he sees smog in the sky, something just snaps within him. It triggers the few remaining braincells left from inhaling so much steam. The rage... the fury... it just makes him want to shoot something! Plant, zombie, doesn't matter! Lotus Root needs to blow off some steam, and you better make sure you're not near him when he does!
UNUSED_46_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lotus Roots spray a flurry of water pellets at zombies in their lanes. Pellets will scatter after being shot, making damage more effective the closer targets are.
UNUSED_47_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}targets leftmost zombies that are 3 columns ahead or behind it
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can be planted on water

{FLAVOR}Cattail is very active on social media, notably on Leafter. She’s mostly known for being an icon of "Cat-Like Creatures who are not actually Cats" independence and frequently voices her controversial opinions on various cat foods.
UNUSED_47_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cattails launch homing spikes at zombies near them.
UNUSED_48_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^00CCA3^Part of the UniverZ Collides collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Alternate UniverZ.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}deals damage to zombies that can't be transformed
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}targets Wizard and Frog Sorceress Zombies first
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}After long studies, Void Orchid discovered a way to travel through the Multiverse itself. "On this Arcane Annual I will have the crowd all to myself", she says, "Look who's superior now, Hazel!" She will have to leave that thought for later though, as now she has a pending lawsuit for bringing zombie species that aren't welcome in our habitat. As if zombies in general were welcome here.
UNUSED_48_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Void Orchids use their dark energy to convert zombies into gravity spheres that pull in nearby zombies from other lanes.
UNUSED_49_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws a bouncy gear forwards and a big gear backwards that rebounds forward, dealing heavy damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}big gear travels 3 tiles backward then rebounds forward
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plant food will permanently upgrade gear damage

{FLAVOR}Maypop Mechanic always had complaints about having to work in such a hazardous environment. She just can't stand all the steam, smog and rotten mustaches from the nearby factory. Going on a worker strike proved futile, as the zombies weren't particularly fond of having a plant around doing their kind of dirty work in the first place.
UNUSED_49_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Maypop Mechanic launches two gears at zombies. One is launched forward and bounces from zombie to zombie before breaking. The other is launched backwards but rebounds forward while dealing heavy damage to a single target.
